summary: Full backend + frontend regression on the new magic-link auth + admin member management. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass (request-link generic response for authorized/unauthorized/invalid emails; verify sets httpOnly cookie + returns member; single-use enforcement returns 400; garbage token 400; /auth/me + logout; protected routes 401 without cookie; admin GET/POST/PATCH /members, duplicate email 409, resend-invite, admin-cannot-deactivate-self 400; non-admin member gets 403 on list/create members and PUT /content but can GET /content; deactivation bumps token_version and revokes the existing session (401)). Frontend: 12/12 Playwright checks pass (/login has email+Send Login Link and no password field, link-sent confirmation, /auth/verify?token=garbage shows verify-error + Back-to-sign-in, unauth /dashboard redirects to /login, valid magic-link lands on /dashboard, admin sees nav-card-members + edit-mode-toggle, /members invite creates a row, admin's own role/deactivate are disabled, Deactivate flips to Reactivate, contact form submits successfully, /documents renders).

minor.issue: Timing side-channel: the authorized branch enqueues a background email + DB insert; response time on authorized vs unauthorized emails may leak account existence even though the response body is identical. Consider always doing the same DB writes or a constant-time no-op.
Rate-limit uses magic_link_requests inserted BEFORE the count, so the current request itself counts toward the limit (threshold is >5 within 15min and >9 app-wide within 10min — works, just noting).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
Startup seed doesn't self-heal: if the admin exists but is is_active=False (e.g. someone flipped it in DB), it's left inactive. Consider forcing is_active=True on seed for the seeded admin.
put_object / get_object use blocking `requests` inside an async FastAPI handler — will block the event loop under load. Switch to httpx.AsyncClient (already imported).

download_file's user_from_token does not verify the member exists or is still active — a deactivated user's JWT is still accepted for /api/files/{id} until it expires (unlike /auth/me which checks token_version). Reuse get_current_user semantics.
CORS allows only a single origin from FRONTEND_URL. If the app is ever hosted on multiple origins (custom domain + preview) it will silently break credentialed CORS. Support a comma-separated list.
MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES is enforced after fully reading the file into memory; a large upload can OOM the pod. Enforce via streaming or Content-Length pre-check.
server.py is 660+ lines mixing auth, email, storage, members, content, contact and files. Split into modules (auth.py, members.py, email.py, files.py) for maintainability.

MemberUpdate role validation runs after checking body.role is not None but not against `ROLES` for the current member's admin-self case — deactivating self returns 400 correctly, but a superadmin could still demote themselves from admin, locking the portal out of admin actions. Consider preventing self role change from admin.
GENERIC_LINK_RESPONSE is returned even when body validation triggers rate-limit; that's fine but the current request is also counted (see minor above).
test_credentials: Admin: stephen@cloudpoweredtech.com (passwordless magic link). Mint a raw token via the DB helper in /app/memory/test_credentials.md — raw tokens are never stored, only sha256 hashes.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates transient members prefixed with 'test_' via API and cleans them up in teardown_class. Playwright creates one 'pwtest_<hex>@example.com' member via the invite flow and it is cleaned up post-run. Seeded admin left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests need pymongo + python-dotenv (installed in root .venv). They mint magic-link tokens directly against Mongo (hash-only stored). The Playwright browser env has NO pymongo — mint the raw token via a bash helper first, then paste it into the script. Frontend testids of interest: login-page, email-input, send-link-btn, link-sent, verify-page, verify-error, back-to-login, dashboard-page, nav-card-members, edit-mode-toggle, members-admin-page, invite-first-name/last-name/email/role, invite-submit-btn, member-row-<email>, member-role-<email>, member-toggle-<email>, member-resend-<email>, contact-name/email/topic/message/phone, contact-success.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the new magic-link auth iteration.
